title: Longitudinal and personalized networks of eating disorder cognitions and behaviors: Targets for precision intervention a proof of concept study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network, intraindividual network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited number of assessment points (28); - No specific measures designed for EMA network analysis; - No established replicability of within-person networks; - Potential instability in network structures.
notes: The paper was preregistered on OSF. Code and data are available according to the paper's declaration.
